set_aside.subject: R0-19 host-only network enforcement
set_aside.text: “An instance listens only on its host's loopback or on an internal network of that same host … The deployment enforces this”
set_aside.question: Which named deployment component or configuration selects the listening interface and guarantees that Registry is not reachable beyond the host, and what must happen when that guarantee cannot be established?
options: Registry selects and validates its bind address at startup
Container or compose networking enforces host-only reachability
The host firewall or reverse proxy enforces host-only reachability
set_aside.default_guess: Make the listen address explicit instance configuration, validate it at startup, and fail startup when it permits reachability beyond the host.
